text: In the accepted UIDL handler, an already known message marked DELETE enters the delete queue without incrementing _newMessageTotal. A FETCH_BODY message increments the total and is retrieved; _messagesToDownload contains FETCH_BODY and TOO_BIG, not DELETE. Preserve that distinction when changing received-message status. The inspected filter tests exercise retrieval and deletion commands, but do not directly assert the displayed received-message count. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: POP3 deletion and body retrieval use different new-message accounting
